# HAZWOPER for RCRA TSD & Hazardous Waste Technicians

> HAZWOPER for RCRA TSD & Hazardous Waste Technicians: 4 self-paced online courses from $89.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs HAZWOPER for RCRA TSD & Hazardous Waste Technicians and wants to compare the courses, prices and lengths, or enroll.
- Each course entry below lists the price per seat, the length, the regulation it follows and an enroll link that opens the checkout.
- For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://hazwoper-tsd.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Annual Refresher - RCRA TSD Operations Training](https://hazwoper-tsd.hazwoperosha.us/#course-138): $89.99 per person, 8 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(p) and 29 CFR 1926.65(p). Enroll: https://hazwoper-tsd.hazwoperosha.us/checkout?course=138. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e). Enroll: https://hazwoper-tsd.hazwoperosha.us/checkout?course=357. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-and-safe-ammonia-handling-refresher-training

In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(p) and 29 CFR 1926.65(p). Enroll: https://hazwoper-tsd.hazwoperosha.us/checkout?course=135. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/24-hour-hazwoper-tsd-operations-p
- [OSHA HAZWOPER and RCRA Hazardous Waste Management Technician Safety Training](https://hazwoper-tsd.hazwoperosha.us/#course-346): $349.99 per person, 40 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 12 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.120(e) and 29 CFR 1926.65(e) and EPA Regulations 40 CFR Part 261 and Part 262.
